item.description: House Republicans are fanning out across the country for August recess hoping to capitalize on silver linings in an otherwise tough midterm environment as they kick off a 100-day sprint to Election Day. They are looking for bright spots in mostly daunting public polling. They are taking every opportunity to tie all Democrats to the far-left candidates [...]

item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] US and Iran pause their attacks after days of escalation
item.description: The United States and Iran paused their attacks for a second straight day Sunday, as efforts continued to bring them back to negotiations on an interim ceasefire deal largely undermined by recent exchanges of fire.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 7-foot alligator struck by car removed from Hillsborough County roadway median
item.description: Drivers along a busy Hillsborough County roadway stopped to watch as deputies and a FWC alligator contractor removed a 7-foot alligator from the median after it was hit by a car.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US pauses attacks on Iran for a second straight day and Tehran does too
item.description: The U.S. paused its attacks on Iran for a second straight day Sunday and Tehran said it had done so too, as efforts continued to bring the countries back to negotiations on an interim ceasefire deal.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: evacuation] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Wildfires in France drive 250,000 people from their homes and creep toward wine city of Bordeaux
